segments.sn35.242:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimilāyaṃ [kimbilāyaṃ (sī. pī.), kimmilāyaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)] viharati gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
segments.sn35.242:1.2: Addasā kho bhagavā mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānaṃ.
segments.sn35.242:1.4: “passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānan”ti?
segments.sn35.242:1.6: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā kimilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.242:1.7: kiṃ nu kho, bhante, orimaṃ tīraṃ … pe …
segments.sn35.242:1.9: Idha, kimila, bhikkhu aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā na vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati.

lines: Saṃkiliṭṭhanti paṭicchannakālato paṭṭhāya asaṃkiliṭṭhā nāma āpatti natthi, evarūpaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ.
Na vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyatīti parivāsamānattaabbhānehi vuṭṭhānaṃ na dissati.
Yā āpatti vuṭṭhānagāminī desanāgāminī, taṃ paṭicchāditakālato paṭṭhāya saṃkiliṭṭhā nāma antarāyikabhāvato.
Evarūpaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhanti paṭicchāditatāya vā duṭṭhullabhāvena vā saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ.
Pāsāṇo nu kho esa khāṇukoti gahetabbadārukkhandhasadiso vutto.
Catūsu apāyesūti pañcakāmaguṇāvaṭṭe patitapuggalo manussalokepi guṇasarīrabhedanena dīgharattaṃ cuṇṇavicuṇṇaṃ āpajjatiyeva, tassa tathā āpannattā.
Sīlassa duṭṭhaṃ nāma natthi, tasmā abhāvattho idha du-saddoti āha “nissīlo”ti.
“Pāpaṃ pāpena sukaran”tiādīsu (udā.48) viya pāpa-saddo nihīnapariyāyoti āha “lāmakadhammo”ti.
Saṅkāya vāti attano vā saṅkāya paresaṃ samācārakiriyaṃ sarati āsaṅkati.
Tāni kammāni pavisatīti tāni kammāni karontānaṃ antare pavisati.
